# Gradient Texture

Creates a scalar gradient from vector coordinates.

`lfs.gradient_texture` · Texture

## How to use

Connect Position for a scene-space gradient.\
Linear uses X; diagonal uses X and Y; spherical and radial use the origin.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vector | `Vector` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Coordinates used to evaluate the gradient. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fac | `Fac` | lfs.float | — | — | Generated gradient value. |
